resources.string: Today\'s guidance, Body, sleep debt and load from this morning\'s read.
One calm summary a week. No daily score pushes.
Open Pawse to read last night

Pawse reads the sleep, heart and cycle data your watch or ring already writes to Health Connect, and turns it into one line of guidance with Body, Sleep and Load behind it. It writes back only the food and weigh-ins you log. Everything stays on this phone. Pawse is not a medical device and does not diagnose anything.
